question: How do I add a new staff member?

scenes.caption: How do I add a new staff member? It takes under a minute.
scenes.narration: How do I add a new staff member? It takes under a minute.

scenes.caption: On Home, find Manage and tap Add on the Staff card.
scenes.narration: On Home, find Manage and tap Add on the Staff card.

scenes.caption: Fill in the name, phone, email, branch, department and gender.
